# Pinned minimal engine closure

The current reviewed pin is `6de59de1c203827edc1bc6faa1bc6184cd126a5f`:361 selected files,308 runtime source/type/data files (including one strategy JSON),37 unchanged original test files. [upstream.lock.json](upstream.lock.json) binds original Git blobs, SHA-256, local bytes, scope, licenses and59 patches. Original patched bytes and the Lorcana MIT license are in provenance; [LICENSE](LICENSE) retains the root notice. P001 explicit matcher preload and P002 disabled environment tracing are retained. RULE-03 P003–P028 inject random/ID/clock paths or remove unsafe legacy defaults; [patch descriptors](../../scripts/engine/patches.json) and the importer reproduce them exactly. No official card catalog, simulator UI or generator is imported.

`@lorcana/vendor-engine` is engine-scope. Its sole export is compiled `dist/kernel.js` and the project-owned narrow declaration. Only engine-lab and server engine-adapter may import that exact entry. Raw upstream sources/tests/types are not application exports. Build bundles mutative1.3.0 and @logtape/logtape2.0.7 into JavaScript, retaining development invariant checks. Bun1.4.2, @logtape/pretty2.0.7 and the raw-suite seedrandom compatibility provider are development/test-only. Production kernel has no Bun/source-loader/Node-environment/seedrandom dependency; build guards enforce this. Upstream source is transpiled and tested; project interfaces pass strict checks without a complete upstream strict-type claim.

`createSyntheticKernel({randomSource,players,startTimestamp,choosingFirstPlayer?})` owns two synthetic character definitions and twelve instances per player. The explicit indexed source supplies floats, bounded integers and domain-separated IDs. Captured command time enters submit; server chooser is randomized and Lab fixes p1. Internal status/submit/snapshot/restore support private reconstruction and quota rollback; wrappers determine exposure, and Lab exposes neither snapshot nor restore. KERNEL_IDENTITY binds source/provenance; the server replay identity additionally hashes actual compiled kernel and adapter bytes. Disposal belongs to wrappers. This is an internal bridge, not a supported external game API or viewer projection.

Unchanged upstream suites use a Bun-only explicit compatibility preload; its noncompetitive defaults cannot activate in production/browser code. The37-file suite and project-owned injection regressions have separate denominators. Use [the runbook](../../docs/runbooks/engine.md), [RULE-03 validation](../../docs/validation/rule-03.md) and [ADR0010](../../docs/adr/0010-secure-randomness-replay.md). No full rules-version or official-card certification is accepted; rewarded/private games remain blocked. CR2.3/set14 dates cannot grant admission.

RULE-04 adds or extends P029–P053 for sourced representative keyword/counter/choice behavior; P019 zone identity is expanded while its original bytes remain pinned. The obsolete pre-declared chosen-event helper leaves the closure. The historical RULE-04 checkpoint had27 unchanged upstream test files; current selection has37 unchanged files. The disposable fixture bridge lives outside this package and is absent from public exports/artifacts. [ADR0011](../../docs/adr/0011-sourced-rule-scenarios.md) and [RULE-04 operation](../../docs/runbooks/rules-certification.md) define the partial qualification and per-card promotion gates.

The upstream refresh reconciles P003–P053 and adds P054–P059 for native counter/payment/effective-state compatibility. See [ADR0012](../../docs/adr/0012-upstream-kernel-refresh.md) and [current validation](../../docs/validation/upstream-engine-review.md). No official definitions or altered upstream assertions are imported.
